facts.text: The Open Door Guarantee covers standard tuition and mandatory university fees for eligible undergraduate students from every U.S. state and territory.

sources.title: Open Door Guarantee Expands Access to Private Christian Education
sources.quote: The program is open to eligible students from every U.S. state and territory. The guarantee covers standard tuition and mandatory university fees, including fees for student activities, digital learning, the Student Health Clinic, residential amenities and orientation.
